To maximize the total reward in a bandit problem, we must balance exploration (trying arms with unknown values) and exploitation (choosing the arm with the highest observed mean). 

Since "Highest Reward" has already been sampled once and yielded a poor result (-0.3), and we have two other arms that have not been sampled at all, it is optimal to explore the other options to identify which arm offers the best distribution.
